name: Punit Kumar Singh
evidence: No address retrieved. GitHub code search for "Punit Kumar Singh" returned 72 hits, all arXiv-mirror READMEs (CSQianDong/Awesome-arXiv-Daily-Reporter, 2shin0/arxiv-ai-mailing, ZenAlexa/agi-brief-history) listing him as first author of arXiv 2510.01247 (CultSportQA / "Let's Play Across Cultures") and 2606.19727 (NRITYAM) -- author lists only, no emails. "Punit Kumar Singh" + iitp.ac.in returned 0. The one GitHub profile hit, Punitsingh-1124, is a self-described full-stack developer from India with no research output -- namesake, rejected. Located the two paper repos via repo search and curled them: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/M-Groot7/CultSportQA/main/README.md is three lines ("Dataset will be released soon.") with no contact; niladrighosh03/NRITYAM has no README or CITATION.cff on main. One WebSearch ("Punit Kumar Singh" IIT Patna email CultSportQA) surfaced only the arXiv HTML for 2510.01247 plus unrelated namesakes (Punit Kumar Pandey, Punit Kumar, Prateek Kumar Singh) and explicitly reported no email. arxiv.org and aclanthology.org, where the paper's author-block emails would be printed, are blocked by the container egress policy.
